subject.title: Feature: Respect userTimezone in memory file timestamps and naming

question: Should bundled `session-memory` filenames and `# Session` headers use `agents.defaults.userTimezone` when configured, or should they keep the shipped host/TZ-local behavior?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes shipped memory artifact naming/header semantics for users whose configured timezone differs from the gateway host timezone.

options.title: Adopt `userTimezone` for session memory
options.body: Make session-memory filenames, fallback slugs, and headers use `agents.defaults.userTimezone` with the existing host/UTC fallback, matching memory auto-flush semantics.

options.title: Keep host-local session memory
options.body: Document that `session-memory` artifacts follow host/TZ-local time and close this as outside the current `userTimezone` contract.

options.title: Add a dedicated memory timezone
options.body: Introduce an explicit memory-artifact timezone setting only if maintainers want session-memory behavior decoupled from both host time and `userTimezone`.

recommendation.title: Adopt `userTimezone` for session memory
recommendation.body: Make session-memory filenames, fallback slugs, and headers use `agents.defaults.userTimezone` with the existing host/UTC fallback, matching memory auto-flush semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This person merged the current session-memory host-local behavior and is the best available owner for the upgrade/product impact of changing it.
